_doc: Invariant 4b': the preference sits AFTER marginal cost, never before it — so it can never make the fleet spend money. Instance 10 is a PAID box (dph 0.50) that this task would fully extend, carrying a large preference; instance -1 is a $0 owned box with no preference. Cost must still win outright: the free box takes it. If the preference ever outranked cost, this fixture flips to 10 and the fleet starts paying for a hand-set knob.
